methods.name: MED-DeepLabv3+
methods.summary: A lightweight semantic segmentation model for landslide identification that replaces the Xception encoder with MobileNetV3, incorporates an Efficient Multi-scale Attention (EMA) module for feature refinement, and introduces a DS-ASPP module using depthwise separable convolutions, Squeeze-and-Excitation, and Strip Pooling.
methods.verbatim: The code and data that support the findings of this study are available from the corresponding author, Zhihua Zhang, upon reasonable request.

availability.author_statement: "The code and data that support the findings of this study are available from the corresponding author, Zhihua Zhang, upon reasonable request."

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is mentioned without a link or reference, and the custom code is not available via a repository or persistent link, being offered only upon request.
